body:
The root becomes findable for anyone willing to look.

Someone watches a pattern name itself across decades, the same fear under different bosses, partners, and cities, and suddenly holds a map with a legend.

With Pluto sextile Chiron, people can reach the root without a crisis forcing them there, following the one thread that runs all the way down.

Somebody still has to go looking.

The insight may sit unused, and unused it stays trivia; the people who apply it once tend to start getting years back.
